records.title: Reliability-Contagion Feasibility in LLM Multi-Agent Networks

records.title: Governed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent LLM Systems

records.title: Easier to Mislead Than to Correct: Harmful and Beneficial Revision in LLM Conformity
records.checked_scope: Main protocol, 3.5, 4.3; PDF page 7 Figure 4 inspected
records.boundary: Simulated peers; harmful and beneficial rates condition on different initial-answer subsets. CoT 63.9 to 36.5 harmful, 52.7 to 32.5 beneficial under respective conditions; not our D4 paired estimate.

records.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking
records.checked_scope: Protocol, Table 6, limitations; PDF page 18 inspected
records.boundary: Corpus N accuracy 0.8583 to 0.0417 with provenance weight, a constructed worst case. Plain false assertions are explicitly not instruction injections. Proposed occupancy remedy not evaluated.

records.title: Trust propagation and structural containment in Multi-agent LLM pipelines

records.title: PIGuard: Prompt Injection Guardrail via Mitigating Overdefense for Free
records.boundary: NotInject tests benign trigger-rich samples. General over-defense and benign retention are not new; corrections-in-network is a narrower proposed test.

records.title: The Task Shield: Enforcing Task Alignment to Defend Against Indirect Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
records.boundary: Task-alignment checking with safety/utility tradeoff. Required strong baseline for permission and action claims.
